description: Regimens of the engine with reference values from the literature. severe_toxicity_rate: share of patients with at least one adverse event of grade 3 or higher. severe_event_rates: share with a grade 3 or higher event of that type. ild_rate: share with drug-related interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis of any grade; null means the sources give no rate and the engine generates none. cardiovascular_event_rate: share of patients with a major adverse cardiovascular event within 48 weeks under androgen deprivation with a GnRH agonist; null for regimens without androgen deprivation. median_treatment_weeks: median time to the end of treatment for reasons other than toxicity. max_treatment_weeks: planned end of treatment. chemotherapy_weeks: weeks during which the chemotherapy part of a combination is given; null means throughout.

nalirifox.source: Wainberg et al. (2023), NAPOLI 3; thrombocytopenia from Nichetti et al. (2024). Neutropenia is the sum of the terms neutropenia (14%) and decreased neutrophil count (10%).

gemcitabine_nab_paclitaxel.source: Wainberg et al. (2023), NAPOLI 3; thrombocytopenia from Nichetti et al. (2024). Neutropenia is the sum of the terms neutropenia (25%) and decreased neutrophil count (14%).

adt_docetaxel.source: Smith et al. (2022), ARASENS, placebo arm; median treatment duration 16.7 months; cardiovascular event rate from the leuprolide arm of HERO (Shore et al., 2020), assumed to hold for androgen deprivation in this setting

adt_docetaxel_abiraterone.source: Fizazi et al. (2022), PEACE-1; median survival 5.72 years; median treatment duration is an assumption; cardiovascular event rate from the leuprolide arm of HERO (Shore et al., 2020), assumed to hold for androgen deprivation in this setting

adt_docetaxel_darolutamide.source: Smith et al. (2022), ARASENS; median treatment duration 41.0 months; median survival was not reached, 66 months is an assumption; cardiovascular event rate from the leuprolide arm of HERO (Shore et al., 2020), assumed to hold for androgen deprivation in this setting

lu_psma_617.source: Sartor et al. (2021), VISION; up to six cycles of six weeks; time to progression from the median imaging-based progression-free survival of 8.7 months; cardiovascular event rate from the leuprolide arm of HERO (Shore et al., 2020), assumed to hold for androgen deprivation in this setting

olaparib.source: de Bono et al. (2020), PROfound; median treatment duration 7.4 months; median survival of cohort A; cardiovascular event rate from the leuprolide arm of HERO (Shore et al., 2020), assumed to hold for androgen deprivation in this setting

trastuzumab_deruxtecan.source: Modi et al. (2022), DESTINY-Breast04; median treatment duration 8.2 months

chemotherapy_single_agent.source: Modi et al. (2022), DESTINY-Breast04, physician's choice arm; median treatment duration 3.5 months

pembrolizumab_chemotherapy.source: Cortes et al. (2022), KEYNOTE-355; treatment-related adverse events of grade 3 to 5; immune-mediated events of grade 3 or 4; median exposure 26.4 weeks
